_about.role: Results-feed scout, Minnesota and its neighbours (MN WI IA ND SD MI IL IN OH MO)
_about.how: Started from CLAUDE.md and the kit's loaders (ballot/lists/<code>.py, ballot/state_local_<code>.py, ballot/<code>_place_votes.py); then one or two requests per site from a script with the kit's User-Agent (congress-catalog/1.0, personal legislative research), 1.5 s apart, and a few public pages read in the Browser pane. No CAPTCHA, bot wall or login was touched; the Minnesota Secretary of State's results hosts were not requested. No file over 5 MB was downloaded; no contact details were printed or stored.
_about.status_codes_seen: 403 + 'Just a moment' = Cloudflare JavaScript challenge; 403 + captcha text = Cloudflare managed challenge. DNS lookups on this router fail about one time in three: every script must use states/net.patient_lookups().

MN.system: State-built Secretary of State election results site (electionresults.sos.mn.gov) plus 'media results' text files on electionresultsfiles.sos.mn.gov

feeds.address_pattern: Media Files: one semicolon-separated text file per office group (U.S. Senate, U.S. House, statewide, legislative, judicial, county, municipal, school district, hospital district), each with state; county id; precinct; office id; office name; district; candidate order; candidate name; suffix; incumbent; party; precincts reporting; precincts total; votes; percent; office total (layout per CLAUDE.md, to be checked against a real file)
feeds.updates: Re-posted through election night as counties report (frequency not checked: host not requested)
feeds.notes: Radware CAPTCHA to this machine, in the Browser pane too (CLAUDE.md). Never requested. John saves the files by hand into states_cache/mn_local/sos/<yyyymmdd>/ and the updater reads that folder.

feeds.address_pattern: same media files (U.S. Representative file)
feeds.notes: same

feeds.address_pattern: media files carry a precinct column; precinct-level rows exist for every office group
feeds.notes: same

feeds.address_pattern: Minnesota Geospatial Commons feature services, 'General Election Results By Precinct <year>' layers under https://enterprise.gisdata.mn.gov/aghost/rest/services/us_mn_state_sos/ (found by layer name)
feeds.updates: Not live: posted after the canvass
feeds.notes: Already read by ballot/mn_place_votes.py for 2012-2024 official precinct results (past results and roll-off inputs, not election night).

MN.races: Everything on the ballot: statewide, Congress, Legislature, judges, county, soil and water, city, township, school, hospital districts (the SOS reports all levels in one system).
MN.vote_types: No: the media files give one total per precinct; absentee ballots are counted into precincts (or the county's absentee board precinct where used). Count-order predictor must use county reporting order, not ballot-type splits.
MN.counties_separate: Not needed: the SOS site carries county and local races for all 87 counties. Hennepin and Ramsey publish nothing separate for live counts (not re-checked).
MN.past_test: Rehearsal needs John to save the 2024 general's (20241105) or the Aug 11, 2026 primary's (20260811) media files into the empty folders states_cache/mn_local/sos/20241105/ and 20260811/ (both exist, both empty on 2026-10-09).
MN.nov3_id: Not applicable (files by date: 20261103). The folder already holds John's candidate files for Nov 3.
MN.blocked: electionresults.sos.mn.gov, electionresultsfiles.sos.mn.gov, candidates.sos.mn.gov and www.sos.mn.gov after a few requests: Radware CAPTCHA (CLAUDE.md). Do not request.
MN.kit_already_reads: ballot/lists/mn.py and ballot/state_local_mn.py read John's saved candidate files (20261103); state_local_mn.py's read_file is the reader for saved SOS text files; ballot/mn_place_votes.py reads past official precinct results from the Geospatial Commons.
MN.plan: Minnesota is a hand-fed state on election night. John downloads the Media Files text files from the Secretary of State's results site in his own browser every so often (every 15 to 30 minutes is realistic) into states_cache/mn_local/sos/20261103/results/; the updater watches that folder, reads the files with the existing semicolon reader, checks each office's precinct counts and totals, and publishes. Because the files carry every level from U.S. Senate down to school and hospital boards with precinct rows, one save covers statewide, congressional and local results at once. Before Nov 3, John should save one set of 20241105 or 20260811 media files so the reader can be rehearsed and the column layout confirmed.

WI.vote_types: Unknown live. Milwaukee's central count of absentee ballots reports late and in large batches (well known; not checked here); county summaries do not split it out in a machine-readable way.

WI.kit_already_reads: ballot/lists/wi.py reads the WEC 'Candidates on Ballot' PDF and the Partisan Primary county-by-county workbook, both carried out of the Browser pane into ballot_cache/wi/; ballot/state_local_wi.py reads county sample ballots; ballot/wi_place_votes.py reads LTSB open-data precinct results (data-ltsb.opendata.arcgis.com), never elections.wi.gov.
WI.plan: Wisconsin has no official live feed a script can read: the state publishes nothing until the canvass, and the big counties sit behind Cloudflare. Election Night should show Wisconsin as 'official count arrives with the canvass' and, on the night, either (a) John saves the Milwaukee and Dane summary PDFs by hand a few times (both are PDF reports, so a reader per county), or (b) the page links out to each county clerk's results page without numbers. Final results come from the WEC canvass workbook (Browser-pane carry-out, as the kit already does). Local races on Nov 3 are only three county offices, so the county PDFs cover them.

feeds.notes: 200 on 2026-10-09 (CloudFront, gzip). 2026 primary EID 126082 version 377216: statewide summary reports by county (TP 99).

feeds.address_pattern: same summary.json (category Federal)
/IA/<EID>/<ver>/json/en/electionsettings.json lists 'participatingcounties' as name|eid|version; each county: /IA/<county>/<county EID>/<ver>/json/en/summary.json
feeds.notes: Already used by ballot/state_local_ia.py (primary_index, primary_parties).

feeds.address_pattern: Clarity county reports: /IA/<county>/<EID>/<ver>/reports/detailxml.zip (precinct and vote-type detail)
feeds.notes: Standard Clarity path, not requested here.

IA.races: Statewide, Congress, Legislature, judicial retention, county offices; city and school elections are odd-year (the Nov 4, 2025 City-School election is on the same system).
IA.vote_types: Likely yes: Clarity detail XML carries VoteType breakdowns (Election Day, Absentee) where counties enter them; Iowa's canvass reports Election Day and Absentee per precinct (ballot/ia_place_votes.py). Not confirmed live.
IA.counties_separate: County pages sit inside the same system. Polk (dmcountyelections.iowa.gov), Linn, Scott, Johnson also post their own pages (addresses in state_local_ia.py).
IA.past_test: https://electionresults.iowa.gov/IA/126082/ (2026 Primary, June 2) and 124196 (2025 City-School Election, Nov 4, 2025: local races). The list holds nothing older than 2025.
IA.nov3_id: Not posted yet on 2026-10-09 (elections.json's newest entry is the 2026 Primary).
IA.kit_already_reads: ballot/state_local_ia.py reads elections.json, current_ver.txt, electionsettings.json and county summary.json (party only); ballot/lists/ia.py reads the SOS canvass PDF; ballot/ia_place_votes.py reads official precinct results.
IA.plan: Live-readable. Poll elections.json until the 2026 General appears, then poll current_ver.txt every 2 to 5 minutes and fetch summary.json only when the version changes (statewide and Congress), plus each county's summary for county offices and legislative seats; detailxml.zip per county gives precincts and vote types for the count-order predictor. Rehearse on EID 126082 and 124196.
